FCTR – Foreign currency translation reserve. The FCTR arises from the consolidation of the foreign owned subsidiary, Heritage Insurance Tanzania Limited. It represents gains and
losses, including the differences arising as a result of translating opening shareholders’ equity using exchange rates at the end of the reporting period rather than exchange rates
at the beginning of the period which are included in a translation reserve account and reported as a separate component of equity.
